inspiration.observed_pattern: A scalar date expression derives an ISO year-week number and ISO week number from one fixed date.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored date literal at the ISO 2020/2021 boundary, retaining YEARWEEK mode 3 and WEEKOFYEAR while removing table setup, row classification, and multiple dates.

fixture_notes: The fixed 2020-12-28 date belongs to ISO week 53 of ISO year 2020; both functions must expose that boundary consistently.
determinism_notes: The date literal is fixed with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.

steps.sql: SELECT YEARWEEK('2020-12-28', 3) AS iso_year_week, WEEKOFYEAR('2020-12-28') AS iso_week
